_comment: MODEL H (Telugu) reasoning finetune. Consumed by common/finetune.py via FinetuneConfig.from_json. Keys beginning with an underscore are documentation.
_init: Starts from Model H's own Phase 2 best.pt (step 10,550, validation
loss 3.4234). finetune.py refuses a checkpoint whose model_config
names a different language. The path is the local staging directory
from common/workspace.py; pass --init to point elsewhere.
_schedule: 8,000 steps x 64 examples = 512,000 presentations, ~4.3 epochs of the
120,000-example training split. Peak 3e-4, 300 warmup steps, cosine
to 3e-5. best.pt is selected on validation exact match every 500
steps, so running long costs GPU minutes and nothing else.
WHY THIS IS THE SECOND SCHEDULE. The first run used 24,000 examples
drawn from 42 training names, batch 32, 3,000 steps at peak 1e-4.
Both models reached training loss ~0.3 while validation loss ROSE
after step 250, and on test (disjoint names) every name-answer task
scored 0 exact match: the models answered with TRAINING names
(e.g. మాధవి, కమల) that were not in the prompt. With so few names, a
closed-set name prior was an easier fit than copying from context.
Its logs and predictions are kept in report/phase3/<lang>/
run1_small_pool/. The fix attacks the shortcut rather than the
optimiser: ~2.7x the names (and items), 5x the examples so no
(name, question) pairing recurs often, and enough steps at a higher
rate for a copy-and-compare solution to be found.
Identical to assamese/configs/finetune_l.json in every value but the
language and checkpoint, so the H/L comparison is not a comparison
name: model_h_reasoning
